escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: A delivery can retain a previously valid handoff after a later material code or test commit and still appear audit-ready even though the certified material identity is stale.

literal_case.procedure: Refreeze the current PR head after post-handoff material drift and rebuild the package against exact-head green CI.
literal_case.expected: The current material head is the only candidate identity and the next commit contains result-only audit artifacts.
literal_case.observed: Exact-head CI runs 35997128024 and 35997128037 are green for current material head c7aad3d1cb57fcae4bb2fe7cfd3bbcc6924be4a1.

prevention_change.evidence: Mandatory post-write-refreeze is used; handoff-only reuse is not used after material drift.

detection_change.evidence: Exact-head CI and direct-parent result-only validation bind the replacement handoff to the current material SHA.
